problem:
The affine transformation $T$ is defined as

$$
x=2u-v+1,\,y=9u-4v+3.
$$

Given that the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ of $T$ is

$$
u=y-4x+a,\,v=by+cx+3,
$$

what is the value of $a+b+c?$

activity_context.topic_title: The Inverse of an Affine Transformation

feedback.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation $T$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-5 & -9 \\ 3 & 6\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Find $a+b+c,$ given that the matrix form of the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}a & -3 \\ 1 & b\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ c\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

Reversing the action of $T,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}Au+b & =x \\ Au & =x-b \\ u & ={A}^{-1}(x-b).\end{aligned}
$$

The matrix form of $T$ gives us the following information:

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}-5 & -9 \\ 3 & 6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}
$$

Next, we calculate the inverse of $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{6\cdot (-5)-(-9)\cdot 3}[\begin{aligned}6 & 9 \\ -3 & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{-3}[\begin{aligned}6 & 9 \\ -3 & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 \\ 1 & \frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u} & ={{[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 \\ 1 & \frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{A}^{-1}}\cdot ({{[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}-{{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}) \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 \\ 1 & \frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 \\ 1 & \frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 \\ 1 & \frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & -3 \\ 1 & \frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ \frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=-2+\frac{5}{3}+\frac{1}{3}=0.
$$
